feature: Ask's moving icons: a flap folds, what flies off leaves whole, lines draw on
summary: Ask an animated envelope and its flap now folds open over its top edge instead of spinning flat through the body; wifi waves draw on one after another and reset cleanly; a paper plane flies off whole and comes back in from the other side.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Ask on the built-in model.

try.do: Press Ask and type: make an animated icon of an envelope opening. Send.
try.shotNote: Frames of the exported SVG as WebKit plays it (the eval's svg-frames), not a window capture. Reel: 2026-11-08-animated-fold-envelope-reel.gif

try.do: Press Space to play it, and watch the flap fold up and back over its top edge.
Export it (File > Export…, SVG) and open the file in Safari: the flap folds there too.
Ask: make an animated icon of a wifi signal, its waves appearing one after another.
try.shotNote: Exported SVG frames, not a window capture. Reel: 2026-11-08-animated-fold-wifi-reel.gif

try.do: Ask: make an animated icon of a paper plane taking off.
try.shotNote: Exported SVG frames, not a window capture. Reel: 2026-11-08-animated-fold-plane-reel.gif

evaluate: Does the envelope's flap read as folding open over its top edge, the way you would open one?
Do the wifi waves read as appearing one after another, and does the restart look deliberate?
Does the plane read as taking off, now that it leaves the frame whole and comes back in from the lower left?
Is the flatter fold in the exported file (no perspective) close enough to what the canvas shows?
rough: The paper plane still falls short: 6 of 10 on reading as a take-off against a bar of 7. The model leaves its speed lines floating after the plane has gone and draws the plane nearly edge to edge. Kept open on this task.
The envelope's letter shows as a heavy dark block while it rises through the open flap; the judge reads it as a smear (reads as asked 7, clean 4).
The wifi dot comes out a squashed oval and the outer wave nearly touches the sides (clean 6).

A fold in the exported SVG is the card seen straight on, squeezed toward its hinge; the canvas adds the camera's perspective. Chose the flat version because SVG has no 3D and an icon's fold reads the same.
These pictures are the exported file played in WebKit by the eval, not captures of the app window: the eval walks never photograph the window.

Held-out set: 56.9 over 53 cases with 8 new animated requests (animated 37.3). On the 45 earlier cases it reads about 60.4 against 66.4 last time; the fall is in drawing and video, which this change does not reach. Filed as an open question.
